data.current_summary: Classify a PDF document for compliance checking
data.current_description:
Upload a PDF and receive document classification (scope, motion type) plus a partial request body for POST /check. The response includes a `supported` boolean: `true` for classifiable federal court filings, `false` (with `confidence: "low"`) for state court forms, blank templates, or non-legal documents. The check_request includes judge, district, scope, and document metadata; you must add is_pro_se, pmc_completed, opposing_party_pro_se, and filing_role before sending to /check.

May take 10-30 seconds to respond.
data.summary_suggestion: Classify PDF and generate compliance check request
data.description_suggestion: Uploads a PDF document and returns its classification (document scope, motion type) along with a partial CheckRequest body for use with POST /check. Returns a `supported` boolean indicating whether the document is a classifiable federal court filing (`true`) or unsupported (state court forms, templates, non-legal documents return `false` with `confidence: "low"`). The returned check_request includes judge, district, scope, and document metadata but requires you to add is_pro_se, pmc_completed, opposing_party_pro_se, and filing_role before submitting to /check. Processing may take 10-30 seconds.
